facts.business: Globus Spirits Limited is an integrated alco-beverage company in India with six strategically located manufacturing facilities and a grain-to-glass business model, producing and distributing alcoholic beverages across diverse categories and price points.

capacity_or_capex.item: New distillery at West Bengal for enhancement of ethanol distillation capacity or to set up distillers for producing first generation ethanol from feed stocks such as cereals, sugarcane, sugar beet etc.
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Moratorium of 1 year and repayment started from July 2022 onwards, repayable in 48 equal instalments

capacity_or_capex.item: New distillery at Jharkhand for enhancement of ethanol distillation capacity or to set up distillers for producing first generation ethanol from feed stocks such as cereals, sugarcane, sugar beet etc.
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Moratorium of 1 year and repayment started from March 2023 onwards, repayable in 48 equal instalments

capacity_or_capex.item: Grains/molasses/cane juice based Ethanol distillery at Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to multiplicity of products, volume of sales transactions, size of distribution network, nature of customers and varied terms of contracts with different customers
